title: What Is DeepInfer? DeepSeek's Apache-2.0 Inference Engine
summary: What is Deepinfer DeepSeek and how it differs from DeepInfra. Review the access methods and pricing for this open-source inference framework.
body_markdown:
## Frequently asked questions


Each answer below stays within what the maker's pages state today. Where they say nothing, the answer is "not stated yet", and the person who owns the evaluation should record it that way.


Is deepinfer the same as DeepInfra? No. Deepinfer is a new release from DeepSeek, while DeepInfra is a separate hosting service. The names differ by two letters, so check the domain on the maker's page before you sign in or paste a key.


Is deepinfer free to use? Not stated yet. Until the maker's pages publish terms, treat it as unpriced and don't assume a free tier. Ask who'd be billed before anyone creates an account or connects a payment method.


Can I use deepinfer with models other than DeepSeek's? Not stated yet. It comes from DeepSeek, but that doesn't tell you what it supports. Read the maker's page for a supported-model list and rely only on that.


### Integration and production questions


Does deepinfer work with an OpenAI-style API? Not stated yet. Don't plan an integration around API compatibility the maker hasn't documented. If a page does describe it, note the authentication method it names, and which permissions a key carries, before you name the risk.


Should I use deepinfer in production now? Not on the evidence available. A hosted version is also not stated yet, so you can't say where your data would run or who'd operate it.


Run the five steps first, record each gap as open, and give one named owner the decision to revisit it when the maker's pages change, so unresolved gaps will resurface once the maker updates their pages.
